CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

R package jnanalytics (repo folder jn_analytics): open data about the journal market in transformative agreements, hybrid and fully open access. Successor of hoaddata 0.3 (~/Documents/hoad/hoaddata, kept frozen); the dashboard is ~/Documents/hoad/hoaddash. Design background: draft_implementation.md (partly superseded by the decisions below).

Commands

devtools::load_all()                 # load the package
devtools::document()                 # after any roxygen change (run twice if links warn)
devtools::test()                     # tests; devtools::test(filter = "analysis")
devtools::check(args = "--no-manual")
source("data-raw/reference.R")       # rebuild the bundled reference tables
targets::tar_make()                  # full pipeline: reference -> BigQuery -> Parquet
pkgdown::build_site()                # website into docs/

How the package is organised

  • inst/schema/columns.csv is the single source of truth for every table’s columns, types, keys and descriptions. It feeds jn_validate(), the Rd @format sections, the BigQuery column descriptions and the Parquet metadata. Edit it with a CSV writer (Python csv or R), never by string replacement: a comma in an unquoted description breaks the file.
  • inst/sql/*.sql are BigQuery templates with {{dataset}}, {{openalex}}, {{crossref}}, {{year_min}}, {{year_max}}, rendered by jn_sql(). Tests check that each template returns the schema’s columns in order.
  • _targets.R is the build pipeline; R/build.R, R/publish.R the build functions; R/analysis.R, R/source.R the analysis layer (dplyr on Parquet via arrow, or BigQuery via dbplyr).
  • data-raw/: the JCT files (jct_jn_all.csv, stored gzipped as jct_jn_all.csv.gz, jct_inst_all.csv, esac_df.csv) are copied in by hand from ~/Documents/r-tools/jct_data/data (github.com/njahn82/jct_data). Do not add automatic fetching. legacy/ holds hoaddata 0.3 inputs, manual/ curated lookups, diagnostics/ generated reports.

BigQuery rules

  • Inputs: only subugoe-collaborative.cr_instant (Crossref) and subugoe-collaborative.openalex_walden (OpenAlex). Output: subugoe-collaborative.jn_analytics. Other datasets (e.g. oa2020.b18_*) are examples at most; do not build on them.
  • Always dry-run first and tell the user the GB and cost; get their OK before billed queries or table builds. Full rebuild is about 245 GB; articles alone about 140 GB. Never query the Crossref reference array (about 480 GB); use reference_count.
  • Auth: jn_bq_auth() (service-account key in CI, cached login locally).

Decisions already made (do not re-open without the user)

  • JCT is the only journal and agreement source; OAM was removed.
  • OpenAlex is the spine (works, types, journal, ISSN-L, OA status); Crossref is joined by DOI only (no date filter) for CC licence and metadata indicators. Years come from OpenAlex; pub_year_crossref is for comparison.
  • All works with a DOI from 2016 on are kept; filter on work_type (research = article, review). No supplement or paratext filters in SQL.
  • CC licence counts for the version of record whatever delay_in_days (the delay filter was too strict and lost ~120k fully OA works in 2025 alone); only accepted-manuscript licences are excluded, plus hoaddata’s delayed-OA exception for four journals.
  • OA: every work in a fully OA journal-year is OA (share 100%); in a hybrid journal-year, OA = CC licence in Crossref. articles_oa counts both; articles_with_cc_license is the Crossref licence evidence alone (a metadata indicator in fully OA journals).
  • Country-agnostic: no scope; country tables use full counting.
  • oa_model per year: hybrid up to and including the OpenAlex oa_flip_year, fully OA afterwards. Publisher-wide flips (ACM from 2026) are curated in data-raw/manual/oa_flips.csv.
  • Agreement coverage: first author; direct, child and parent ROR matches count, related is stored but not counted; the period is checked with the OpenAlex publication date only.
  • portfolios is one row per page and agreement (agreement_id = ESAC ID); a page’s journals come from agreement_journals. The ESAC IDs per page are essential to the user.
  • Statistics per ESAC ID are journal-level (all works in the agreement’s journals, during the agreement period by default): jn_oa(by = "agreement_id"), agreement = filter. Author-matched coverage is the separate agreement_journal_year table.
  • Analysis functions default to all journals (oa_model = NULL).
  • The Parquet export (parquet/) is committed to the repo, by the build workflow after each build, so each release is shared and versioned in git.
  • The build workflow is started by hand (roughly quarterly); no cron.

Conventions

  • Function prefix jn_; internal helpers have no roxygen docs.
  • Base pipe |>; cli::cli_abort() with call = pointing to the user-facing function.
  • Tests mirror R/ files; errors are tested with expect_snapshot(error = TRUE); prefer specific expectations over expect_true().
  • Every user-facing change gets a NEWS.md bullet; new exported topics go into _pkgdown.yml.
  • Keep references to “hoaddata 0.3” where they describe data provenance.
